name: CAMB.AI MARS-Instruct
access: CAMB.AI API: streaming text-to-speech (POST), speech_model mars-instruct, with Python and TypeScript SDKs and a live WebSocket
Cloud marketplaces and on-device SDKs listed for MARS 8 (25+ compute platforms per the launch post)

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with inline emotion, delivery and sound tags, a user_instructions field and SSML-style breaks
voice.output_audio: wav, flac, adts and raw PCM (pcm_s16le, pcm_s32be, pcm_s32le, pcm_f32le, pcm_f32be) for mars-instruct, at 22.05 kHz [camb-stream] [camb-models]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a reference voice (a voice id), voices created from a text description, and a list of public and shared voices [camb-index] [camb-emotion]
voice.latency: The maker states higher latency and no real-time use for mars-instruct; it has no time-to-first-byte figure [camb-models] [camb-choose]
voice.session_limit: 3 to 3,000 characters of text per request [camb-stream]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Not per token. The pricing page shows monthly credit plans from 5K to 1.35M credits at US$0 to US$900 and gives no per-character or per-minute rate or a MARS-Instruct line [camb-pricing]

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model
max_output: not published in tokens; the limit is 3,000 characters of text per request
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (credit plans); no per-character rate was found, see notes
benchmarks: no independent measurement of MARS-Instruct was found; Artificial Analysis lists no CAMB.AI model on its text-to-speech page (read 2026-10-04)
system_card: CAMB.AI publishes no system card for MARS-Instruct in the pages read
